scenarios.name: Hands that start with eliminated players are tracked (the Milestone 2 stall)

checks.name: play continued over 4+ hands (Milestone 2 stopped at the first hand after an elimination)
no hand refused as missed or untracked
the eliminated seats 2 and 6 were recognised (not treated as folds)
every confirmed action matches the dealer, in order
no incorrect click, no invalid wager
no uncertain / ambiguous / timed-out action

scenarios.name: A tournament is played to its end; the end is a normal stop

checks.name: the table recognised the end of the tournament
the winner is the dealer's winner
one player holds every chip (final player count 1)
lifecycle STOPPED with cause tournament-complete; run() ended
dashboard message: "Tournament finished. Automated gameplay has stopped normally."
eliminations during play were recognised
the tracker refused no reading (except the unseen opening of a hand that needed no decision)
frames the reader could not read are rare (at most 5 % of readings; each refused, never guessed)
every confirmed action matches the dealer, in order; nothing applied unconfirmed
no incorrect click, no invalid wager
no capture and no input after the end
Resume does not restart a finished tournament
